The next phase of the Bank of England’s stress test of private credit will focus on how market participants act collectively and whether that may amplify any shocks.

Speaking at Bloomberg’s Credit Forum in London on Wednesday, the Bank of England’s Nathanaël Benjamin said the next phase of its work will focus on how risks can spread through the financial system. Benjamin is the central bank’s executive director for financial stability, strategy and risk.
